tb21_profile.skill: Design a packing/quantisation heuristic -- cluster prompt lengths into at most 8 aligned shapes, then group requests into batches -- so a supplied analytical cost model falls under four hard numeric thresholds
tb21_profile.domain: LLM inference serving on fixed-shape accelerators: seq/heads/hidden alignment, padding waste, per-shape compilation cost, P95 latency; JSONL request/plan I/O
tb21_profile.task_form: optimise-for-a-budget against a provided cost model, plus implement-from-spec under hard structural constraints (every request exactly once, MAX_SHAPES=8, uniform shape per batch)

verifier_notes: No grade I checked looked wrong for this task. Terminal-Lego's two best entries here (task_14903 rectangle packing, task_12096 P99 latency) are graded weak but both have many substantive assertions (2/15 and 8/37 pinned) rather than being file-exists suites, so weak understates them; neither is FREE so both are eligible. TerminalWorld's closest-by-retrieval entry tw_127063 (performance benchmarking pipeline) is FREE and excluded.

notes: Both new corpora earn their place here. CalibForge's optimization_* family (I enumerated all 59 of them) is a dense supply of beat-a-slow-baseline combinatorial-optimisation tasks that the v1 pool has only sparsely, and its paged-KV-cache task is the single closest domain match in the whole pool. Terminal-Lego contributes two genuine wins the v1 pool does not have: rectangle packing into power-of-two containers (task_14903) and an optimal-GPU-batch-size calculator (task_13552). TMax is the strongest v1 pool here -- it has real bin-packing and cost-model tasks. Recursive-Task-Synthesis has nothing: repeated searches for packing, knapsack, allocation and optimisation returned only Kubernetes/liara deployment-summary boilerplate, so ranks 4-10 there are filler at overall 1-2 and the merge step should discount that corpus entirely for this task. SWE-Smith likewise: only ranks 1-3 are defensible and even those are a stretch. SWE-Rebench's batching content is DL-library shape bugs, useful on domain, poor on task_form as expected.
